question: As per international standards, what is the official width of a singles badminton court?
solution: The correct answer is __**6.10 metres**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The official width of a **singles badminton court**, as per **international standards**, is **6.10 metres** (20 feet). • Badminton court dimensions are standardized by the **Badminton World Federation (BWF)**, which governs the rules and regulations of the game globally. • For singles matches, the court's width is reduced to **6.10 metres**, while its total length remains **13.40 metres**. • The reduced width ensures fair play, as only the inner sidelines are used during singles games. • This measurement allows players to have a balanced playing area, ensuring that the game is competitive and follows international norms.
